authority_exclusions: No Royal in Academy name; no Imperial in Nyssarian Air Force name
Nyssarian aircraft use non-spellcasting technology, guns and bombs
MF-51 engine type is not fixed to V12 ICE; mana-generator-powered electric technology is possible but no Nyssarian spellcasting
Original experimental balloon must not inherit redesigned fire-resistant heating assembly
Sky Sail requires two crew: Wind Mage pilot and attack officer
Mana-crystal color represents current charge, size represents capacity
Watchtower may use stone, metal and glass; no unsupported location or ownership canon
